items.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF Sees $213M Outflow as CPI Report Tests Crypto Markets
items.summary: BlackRock Bitcoin and Ethereum investment products(ETF) recorded huge withdrawals as investors prepared for another important US CPI report. items.title: BlackRock (BLK) Stock May Be 5% Undervalued On AI Opportunity Push
items.summary: BlackRock has ridden a powerful multi year run in its share price. The question now is whether today’s valuation is supported by the returns the asset manager earns on the capital it deploys. Over the past 3 years the stock has returned 96.3%, which puts real pressure on the idea that its current price still lines up with the returns it generates on invested capital.
